title: Callvale after: an endpoint service for the bank, a transit gateway for Callvale
claim: The bank's interface endpoint reaches Callvale's API through an endpoint service, and Callvale's VPCs meet at a transit gateway.
alt: After: an interface endpoint in the bank's VPC connects to Callvale's endpoint service and Network Load Balancer in front of the API. Callvale's production, development and staging VPCs attach to a transit gateway in the network account. Gateway and interface endpoints reach AWS services.
notes: Brief 11 story pair, after (2-deep.md#decision-record, after Decision). Title and alt equal brief.json and 2-deep.md; the claim equals the Markdown caption (shortened to fit 20 words); no steps. Same cells as vpc-connectivity-before: bank application A1, dev and staging VPCs B1, Callvale API B4. The bank's interface endpoint takes the place of the internet at A2. Group labels stay short because the PrivateLink and transit gateway arrows enter the Prod VPC box under its label; the shared CIDR block is the before picture's point. No AWS number in the drawing.
